customer.business: Almissa Digital: multilingual websites for small tourism businesses, Omiš/Croatia
customer.target: Owners of small tourism businesses on the Omiš to Makarska coast (taxi/transfer, tours/rafting/boats, restaurants, holiday villas and apartment houses) whose website is missing, outdated, or only a Facebook page, and who are not technical
customer.where: Omiš, Split and the Makarska Riviera, Croatia

segments.name: Taxi, transfer, tour, rafting or boat operator (takes direct bookings by phone/WhatsApp)
Villa or apartment-house owner wanting direct bookings to avoid Booking.com commission
Single-apartment host or small trade (only a Facebook page now)

behaviours.name: Facebook-and-Instagram only
behaviours.how: Thinks the Facebook page and Google Maps listing are enough; has never had a website.

behaviours.name: Has an old site
behaviours.how: A site built 5 to 10 years ago by a friend or agency, not mobile-friendly, prices out of date, only in Croatian and English.

behaviours.name: Commission-hater
behaviours.how: Pays 15-25% to Booking.com, GetYourGuide or Viator and wants more direct bookings.

behaviours.name: DIY tempted
behaviours.how: Has looked at Wix or asked a nephew; would rather spend nothing.

behaviours.name: Cost-cutter
behaviours.how: Avoids any monthly fee and anything not obviously paying back this season.

behaviours.name: Review and Google-ranking focused
behaviours.how: Checks where they appear on Google Maps and what guests see first.

behaviours.name: Early adopter
behaviours.how: Already uses WhatsApp Business and online booking; wants something modern.

objections: My Facebook page and Google Maps listing already bring guests

your daughter runs the Instagram account
you pay commission to a booking platform on most bookings

pitch:
Almissa Digital, from Omiš: a modern website for your tourism business.
A fast, mobile-friendly website in up to 6 languages (Croatian, English, German, Polish, Italian, Czech), with clear prices, photos, Google reviews, and a "Book on WhatsApp" button that sends you the route or date and number of people.
Includes setting up or tidying your Google Maps profile and basic Google search setup. Built in 2 to 3 weeks; we meet in person in Omiš, Split or Makarska, and you approve everything before it goes live.
Price: €600 one-time for the website. Then €15 a month for the care plan: hosting, your domain, security updates, and changes to prices, texts and photos whenever you send them by WhatsApp (within 2 working days). No long contract.
The domain is registered in your name and the site is yours.
Answer the price questions about the ONE-TIME website price in euros (not the monthly fee).
